# QuizSift

> QuizSift is a free scored quiz builder: create a lead-qualification or product-recommendation quiz in minutes, share it with a link, and give each respondent an instant score-based outcome. No account needed. A free alternative to ScoreApp and Typeform quizzes. Built by Siva Dheeraj.

## Facts
- Free; no signup required to build or take a quiz
- Scored outcomes: each respondent gets an instant result based on their score
- Use cases: lead qualification quizzes, product recommendation quizzes
- Comparison pages: /free-scoreapp-alternative.html, /typeform-quiz-alternative.html, /lead-qualification-quiz.html, /product-recommendation-quiz.html

## Links
- App: https://quizsift.vercel.app/
